"""VFN-IF baseline for ai4bio-protein-inverse-folding.

Reference: github.com/aim-uofa/VFN @ 9f5b1e12bf2d6bc4b7fdc1f188a837a17daa77dd, VFN-IF/
           (unifold/modules/VFN.py, prodesign_module.py, common.py, frame.py,
            inverse_module_utils/pifold_featurizer.py, pifold_utils.py, data/data_ops.py,
            config.py VFN_baseline_wo_node_feat_15l, train_script/layers/*_15l.sh)
Paper: Mao et al., "De novo Protein Design Using Geometric Vector Field Networks",
       ICLR 2024 (spotlight), arXiv:2310.11802. Table 1: CATH4.2 recovery 54.74 /
       perplexity 4.17 without a protein language model (PiFold 51.66 / 4.55).

Provenance: faithful, no deviations. The released VFN_baseline_wo_node_feat_15l model
(15 VFN layers, hidden 128, 32 vectors, vector-field operator with GBF distances and
direction terms, V-MLP, PiFold's global context gating, zero-initialised readout), the
config whose recovery in the paper's layer ablation (Table 6a, w/o edge feature, 15
layers: 54.7) matches Table 1's 54.74 and whose training script uses its own seed
(3407). Batch 8 and lr 1e-3 are the script's values (CONFIG_OVERRIDES). The forward
of the released model rebuilds its node input from the backbone atoms and sets its
edge input to a constant (VFN.py:117-119), so the featurizer's hand-crafted features
it discards are not computed; all parameters of the reference model are kept,
including the ones the forward never reads, so the parameter count is the reference's
(12,107,189 total, 12,103,093 trainable).
"""

_FILE = "ProteinInvBench/custom_invfold.py"

_CONTENT = r'''# =====================================================================
# EDITABLE SECTION START — VFN-IF baseline
# =====================================================================
# VFN-IF (Mao et al., "De novo Protein Design Using Geometric Vector Field
# Networks", ICLR 2024 spotlight; arXiv:2310.11802), ported from the authors'
# code, github.com/aim-uofa/VFN @ 9f5b1e12bf2d6bc4b7fdc1f188a837a17daa77dd,
# directory VFN-IF/ (file:line references are to that commit):
#   input     unifold/modules/denoise.py:66-103 (Denosie.forward), backbone frames
#             unifold/data/data_ops.py:1012-1133,1313-1316 (atom37_to_frames, group 0)
#   featurizer unifold/modules/inverse_module_utils/pifold_featurizer.py:8-310
#             (+ pifold_utils.py:134-161 _orientations_coarse_gl_tuple_uni_backen,
#              :250-254 gather_nodes; modules/frame.py Rotation/Frame)
#   model     unifold/modules/VFN.py:7-144 (VFN), prodesign_module.py:16-410
#             (NeighborAttention, EdgeMLP, Context, GeneralGNN, StructureEncoder,
#              MLPDecoder), common.py:20-75,77-141,245-299,458-515 (Linear inits,
#              GeoVecMLP, VecLinear, FakeLinear, GeoVecLinear, GaussianLayer,
#              GaussianNondeLayer, residual, vec<->tensor)
#   config    unifold/config.py:300-344 (VFN defaults) + :685-692
#             (VFN_baseline_wo_node_feat_15l), train_script/layers/
#             x2_vecdirect_noedge_atom_gbf_nofeat_15l.sh (batch 8, lr 1e-3)
# Faithful, no deviations: every module, flag and initialisation of the
# released VFN_baseline_wo_node_feat_15l model, including the reference's
# parameters that the forward pass never reads (featurizer virtual atoms,
# norm_edges, W_e, per-layer W11-13 / norm[2] / Context.V_MLP /
# vector_dist_bn / h_V_vector_edge_mlp), so the parameter set equals the
# reference model's. The released forward discards the featurizer's
# hand-crafted node/edge features (VFN.py:117-119 rebuild h_V from the
# backbone atoms and set the edge input to a constant 1), so those dead
# feature tensors are not computed here; everything the forward reads
# (kNN graph, frames, neighbour frames, local backbone atoms) is.
# The harness mask plays the reference's seq_mask (residues the model sees);
# the flat per-residue logits are scattered back to (B, L, 20) log-probs
# (residues outside the mask: uniform, never scored).

import numpy as np
from torch_scatter import scatter_sum, scatter_softmax, scatter_mean


# ---- modules/frame.py (Rotation / Frame, the subset the model uses) ----
class _VRotation:
    def __init__(self, mat):
        self._mat = mat

    @staticmethod
    def mat_mul_mat(a, b):
        return (a.float() @ b.float()).type(a.dtype)

    @staticmethod
    def mat_mul_vec(r, t):
        return (r.float() @ t.float().unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1).type(t.dtype)

    def __getitem__(self, index):
        if not isinstance(index, tuple):
            index = (index,)
        return _VRotation(self._mat[index + (slice(None), slice(None))])

    def __matmul__(self, other):
        return _VRotation(_VRotation.mat_mul_mat(self._mat, other._mat))

    def invert(self):
        return _VRotation(self._mat.transpose(-1, -2))

    def apply(self, pts):
        return _VRotation.mat_mul_vec(self._mat, pts)

    def invert_apply(self, pts):
        return _VRotation.mat_mul_vec(self._mat.transpose(-1, -2), pts)


class _VFrame:
    def __init__(self, rotation, translation):
        self._r = rotation
        self._t = translation

    @property
    def shape(self):
        return self._t.shape[:-1]

    def __getitem__(self, index):
        if type(index) != tuple:
            index = (index,)
        return _VFrame(self._r[index], self._t[index + (slice(None),)])

    def compose(self, other):
        return _VFrame(self._r @ other._r, self._r.apply(other._t) + self._t)

    def decompose(self, other):
        return _VFrame(self._r.invert() @ other._r, self._r.invert_apply(other._t - self._t))

    def apply(self, pts):
        return self._r.apply(pts) + self._t

    def invert_apply(self, pts):
        return self._r.invert_apply(pts - self._t)

    def repeat(self, repeat_size):
        self._r._mat = self._r._mat.repeat(repeat_size + [1, 1])
        self._t = self._t.repeat(repeat_size + [1])
        return self

    def gather(self, dim, index):
        if dim < 0:
            dim = len(self.shape) + dim
        shape_index = list(index.shape)
        index_r = index[..., None, None].expand(shape_index + [3, 3])
        index_t = index[..., None].expand(shape_index + [3])
        self._r._mat = torch.gather(self._r._mat, dim=dim, index=index_r)
        self._t = torch.gather(self._t, dim=dim, index=index_t)
        return self

    @staticmethod
    def from_3_points(p_neg_x_axis, origin, p_xy_plane, eps=1e-8):
        p_neg_x_axis = torch.unbind(p_neg_x_axis, dim=-1)
        origin = torch.unbind(origin, dim=-1)
        p_xy_plane = torch.unbind(p_xy_plane, dim=-1)
        e0 = [c1 - c2 for c1, c2 in zip(origin, p_neg_x_axis)]
        e1 = [c1 - c2 for c1, c2 in zip(p_xy_plane, origin)]
        denom = torch.sqrt(sum((c * c for c in e0)) + eps)
        e0 = [c / denom for c in e0]
        dot = sum((c1 * c2 for c1, c2 in zip(e0, e1)))
        e1 = [c2 - c1 * dot for c1, c2 in zip(e0, e1)]
        denom = torch.sqrt(sum((c * c for c in e1)) + eps)
        e1 = [c / denom for c in e1]
        e2 = [e0[1] * e1[2] - e0[2] * e1[1],
              e0[2] * e1[0] - e0[0] * e1[2],
              e0[0] * e1[1] - e0[1] * e1[0]]
        rots = torch.stack([c for tup in zip(e0, e1, e2) for c in tup], dim=-1)
        rots = rots.reshape(rots.shape[:-1] + (3, 3))
        return _VFrame(_VRotation(rots), torch.stack(origin, dim=-1))


def _vfn_backbone_frames(X):
    # data_ops.py:1012-1133 atom37_to_frames, rigid group 0 (base atoms C, CA, N for
    # every residue type) composed with diag(-1, 1, -1); :1313 true_frame_tensor.
    gt = _VFrame.from_3_points(p_neg_x_axis=X[..., 2, :], origin=X[..., 1, :],
                               p_xy_plane=X[..., 0, :], eps=1e-8)
    rots = torch.eye(3, dtype=X.dtype, device=X.device)
    rots[0, 0] = -1
    rots[2, 2] = -1
    rots = rots.expand(gt.shape + (3, 3))
    return gt.compose(_VFrame(_VRotation(rots), torch.zeros(gt.shape + (3,), dtype=X.dtype,
                                                            device=X.device)))


def _vfn_gather_nodes(nodes, neighbor_idx):
    neighbors_flat = neighbor_idx.view((neighbor_idx.shape[0], -1))
    neighbors_flat = neighbors_flat.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, nodes.size(2))
    neighbor_features = torch.gather(nodes, 1, neighbors_flat)
    return neighbor_features.view(list(neighbor_idx.shape)[:3] + [-1])


# ---- modules/common.py ----
class VLinear(nn.Linear):
    def __init__(self, d_in, d_out, bias=True, init="default"):
        super().__init__(d_in, d_out, bias=bias)
        self.use_bias = bias
        if self.use_bias:
            with torch.no_grad():
                self.bias.fill_(0)
        if init in ("default", "glorot"):
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.weight, gain=1)
        elif init == "final":
            self._zero_init(False)
        else:
            raise ValueError("Invalid init method.")

    def _zero_init(self, use_bias=True):
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.weight.fill_(0.0)
            if use_bias:
                self.bias.fill_(1.0)


def _vfn_residual(residual, x, training):
    if training:
        return x + residual
    residual += x
    return residual


def _vec_to_tensor(vec):
    return vec.flatten(1)


def _tensor_to_vec(tensor):
    return tensor.reshape(tensor.shape[0], -1, 3)


class GeoVecLinear(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_vec_in, num_vec_out, bias=False):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_vec_in, self.num_vec_out, self.bias_enable = num_vec_in, num_vec_out, bias
        if num_vec_in == num_vec_out:
            self.Linear = VLinear(num_vec_in, num_vec_in, bias=False, init="final")
        else:
            self.Linear = VLinear(num_vec_in, num_vec_out, bias=False)
        if self.bias_enable:
            self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_vec_out, 3))

    def forward(self, vec):
        if self.num_vec_in == self.num_vec_out:
            vec_update = self.Linear(vec.transpose(-2, -1)).transpose(-2, -1)
            if self.bias_enable:
                vec_update = vec_update + self.bias[None]
            return _vfn_residual(vec, vec_update, self.training)
        vec = self.Linear(vec.transpose(-2, -1)).transpose(-2, -1)
        if self.bias_enable:
            vec = vec + self.bias[None]
        return vec


class VecLinear(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_vec_in, num_vec_out, type):
        super().__init__()
        assert type == "geometric"
        self.Linear = GeoVecLinear(num_vec_in, num_vec_out)

    def forward(self, vec):
        return self.Linear(vec)


class FakeLinear(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_vec_in, num_vec_out, type):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_vec_in, self.num_vec_out, self.type = num_vec_in, num_vec_out, type
        self.linear = VLinear(num_vec_in * 3, num_vec_out * 3)

    def forward(self, vec):
        vec = vec.reshape(vec.shape[0], -1)
        vec = self.linear(vec)
        return vec.reshape(vec.shape[0], self.num_vec_out, 3)


class GeoVecMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_vec_in, n=2, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_vec_in, self.n = num_vec_in, n
        self.Linear1 = GeoVecLinear(num_vec_in, num_vec_in * n, bias=True)
        self.Linear2 = GeoVecLinear(num_vec_in * n, num_vec_in, bias=True)
        self.Linear2.Linear._zero_init(False)
        self.dir_vec = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(num_vec_in * n, 3))
        self.dropout = dropout
        self.drop_n = int(num_vec_in * dropout)
        self.scale_factor = 1.0 / (1 - self.drop_n / num_vec_in)

    def forward(self, vec):
        vec_res = vec
        vec = self.Linear1(vec)
        cos_sim = torch.einsum("bnc,nc->bn", vec, self.dir_vec) / (
            torch.norm(vec, dim=-1) * torch.norm(self.dir_vec, dim=-1) + 1e-8)
        dir_factor = (cos_sim + 1) / 2
        vec = vec * dir_factor.unsqueeze(-1)
        vec = self.Linear2(vec)
        if self.training:
            dropmask = torch.rand(vec.shape[:2], device=vec.device) <= self.dropout
            vec[dropmask] = 0
            vec = vec * self.scale_factor
        return vec + vec_res


class GeoVecMLPMultiLayers(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_vec_in, n=2, num_layers=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.layers = nn.Sequential(*[GeoVecMLP(num_vec_in, n) for _ in range(num_layers)])

    def forward(self, vec):
        return self.layers(vec)


def _vfn_gaussian(x, mean, std):
    return torch.exp(-0.5 * (((x - mean) / std) ** 2))


class GaussianLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_hidden, num_vec, K=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.mean = VLinear(num_hidden * 2, num_vec * K, init="final")
        self.var = VLinear(num_hidden * 2, num_vec * K, init="final")
        self.anchor_means = nn.Parameter(torch.linspace(0, 20, K)[None].repeat(num_vec, 1), requires_grad=False)
        self.anchor_var = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_vec, K) * (20 / (K / 2)), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x, h_src, h_dst):
        nodes = torch.cat([h_src, h_dst], dim=-1)
        mean = self.mean(nodes)
        var = self.var(nodes)
        mean = mean.view(mean.shape[0], -1, 4)
        var = var.view(mean.shape[0], -1, 4)
        mean = (mean + self.anchor_means[None]).abs()
        var = (var + self.anchor_var[None]).abs() + 0.5
        return _vfn_gaussian(x[..., None], mean, var).flatten(1, 2)


class GaussianNondeLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_vec, K=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.anchor_means = nn.Parameter(torch.linspace(0, 20, K)[None].repeat(num_vec, 1), requires_grad=False)
        self.anchor_var = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_vec, K) * (20 / (K / 2)), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        mean = (self.anchor_means[None]).abs()
        var = (self.anchor_var[None]).abs() + 0.5
        return _vfn_gaussian(x[..., None], mean, var).flatten(1, 2)


# ---- modules/prodesign_module.py (VFN_baseline_wo_node_feat_15l flags) ----
_VFN_CFG = dict(num_vec=32, vec_mlp_n=2, vec_num_mlp_layer=2, vec_learnable=True,
                use_simple_mlp=False, use_simple_relu=False, use_simple_gvp=False,
                enable_vec_direct=True, dist_gbf=True, decompose=True,
                use_mlp_in_edge=True, disable_edge_module=False,
                use_vec_update_edge=True, cross_update=False,
                vector_field_post_vec_norm=False, init_vec='linear',
                per_layer_supervision=False)


class VFNNeighborAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_hidden, num_in, num_heads=4, edge_drop=0.0, output_mlp=True):
        super().__init__()
        c = _VFN_CFG
        self.num_heads, self.num_hidden, self.edge_drop, self.output_mlp = num_heads, num_hidden, edge_drop, output_mlp
        self.num_vec = c['num_vec']
        self.W_V = nn.Sequential(VLinear(num_in, num_hidden), nn.GELU(),
                                 VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden), nn.GELU(),
                                 VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden))
        self.vector_V = VecLinear(self.num_vec, self.num_vec, "geometric")
        self.Bias = nn.Sequential(VLinear(num_hidden * 3, num_hidden), nn.ReLU(),
                                  VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden), nn.ReLU(),
                                  VLinear(num_hidden, num_heads * 2))
        self.W_O = VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden, bias=False)
        self.edge_vector_field_linear = VecLinear(self.num_vec * 2, self.num_vec, "geometric")
        self.edge_vector_field_linear.Linear.Linear._zero_init(False)
        self.vector_dist_bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(self.num_vec)
        self.final_vector_output = VLinear(self.num_vec * 3, self.num_vec * 3, bias=True, init='final')
        self.vec_merge_v_src = VecLinear(self.num_vec * 2, self.num_vec, "geometric")
        self.vec_merge_v_src.Linear.Linear._zero_init(False)
        self.vec_merge_v_src_mlp = GeoVecMLPMultiLayers(self.num_vec, n=c['vec_mlp_n'], num_layers=c['vec_num_mlp_layer'])
        self.h_V_vector_edge_mlp = GeoVecMLPMultiLayers(self.num_vec, n=c['vec_mlp_n'], num_layers=c['vec_num_mlp_layer'])
        self.softmax_dropout = 0.2
        self.gbf = GaussianLayer(num_hidden, self.num_vec)
        self.h_e_reducer = VLinear(num_hidden * 2 + 4 * self.num_vec + 3 * self.num_vec, num_hidden * 2, bias=False)

    def forward(self, h_V, h_E, center_id, batch_id, dst_idx=None, frame_dst=None, h_V_vector=None):
        E = h_E.shape[0]
        n_heads = self.num_heads
        d = int(self.num_hidden / n_heads)
        h_V_vector_init = h_V_vector
        h_V_vector_src = h_V_vector[center_id]
        h_V_vector_dst = h_V_vector[dst_idx]
        h_V_vector_dst_trans = frame_dst[:, None].apply(h_V_vector_dst)
        h_V_vector_edge = torch.cat([h_V_vector_dst_trans, h_V_vector_src], dim=-2)
        h_V_vector_edge = self.edge_vector_field_linear(h_V_vector_edge) + h_V_vector_dst_trans
        h_V_vector_dist = h_V_vector_edge.norm(dim=-1) + 1e-6
        h_V_vector_edge_sin_cos = h_V_vector_edge / h_V_vector_dist[..., None]
        h_V_vector_dist = self.gbf(h_V_vector_dist, h_V[center_id], h_V[dst_idx])
        vector_field_feat_to_s = torch.cat([h_V_vector_edge_sin_cos.flatten(start_dim=1), h_V_vector_dist], dim=1)
        h_E = torch.cat([vector_field_feat_to_s, h_E], dim=-1)
        h_E = self.h_e_reducer(h_E)
        dtype = h_V.dtype
        w = self.Bias(torch.cat([h_V[center_id], h_E], dim=-1)).view(E, n_heads * 2, 1)
        w = w.float()
        attend_logits = w / np.sqrt(d)
        if self.softmax_dropout > 0 and self.training:
            mask = torch.rand_like(attend_logits, dtype=dtype) < self.softmax_dropout
            attend_logits.masked_fill_(mask, -float('inf'))
        V = self.W_V(h_E).view(-1, n_heads, d)
        attend = scatter_softmax(attend_logits, index=center_id, dim=0)
        attend = attend.type(dtype)
        attend, attend_vector = attend.split([4, 4], dim=1)
        h_V = scatter_sum(attend * V, center_id, dim=0).view([-1, self.num_hidden])
        h_V_update = self.W_O(h_V) if self.output_mlp else h_V
        h_V_vector_edge_v = self.vector_V(h_V_vector_dst_trans)
        # rearrange 'l (h v) c -> l h v c'
        h_V_vector_edge_v = h_V_vector_edge_v.reshape(h_V_vector_edge_v.shape[0], n_heads, -1, 3)
        h_V_vector_v = scatter_sum(attend_vector[..., None] * h_V_vector_edge_v, center_id, dim=0).flatten(1, 2)
        h_V_vector_v = self.vec_merge_v_src(torch.cat([h_V_vector_v, h_V_vector], dim=-2)) + h_V_vector_v
        h_V_vector_v = self.vec_merge_v_src_mlp(h_V_vector_v)
        h_V_vector_v = _vec_to_tensor(h_V_vector_v)
        h_V_vector = self.final_vector_output(h_V_vector_v)
        h_V_vector = _tensor_to_vec(h_V_vector)
        h_V_vector = h_V_vector + h_V_vector_init
        return h_V_update, h_V_vector, vector_field_feat_to_s


class VFNEdgeMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_hidden, num_in, dropout=0.1, num_heads=None, scale=30):
        super().__init__()
        c = _VFN_CFG
        self.num_hidden, self.num_in, self.scale, self.num_vec = num_hidden, num_in, scale, c['num_vec']
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.norm = nn.BatchNorm1d(num_hidden)
        self.W11 = VLinear(num_hidden + num_in + self.num_vec * 7, num_hidden, bias=True)
        self.W12 = VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden, bias=True)
        self.W13 = VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden, bias=True)
        self.act = torch.nn.GELU()

    def forward(self, h_V, h_E, edge_idx, batch_id, vector_field_feat_to_s):
        src_idx, dst_idx = edge_idx[0], edge_idx[1]
        h_EV = torch.cat([h_V[src_idx], h_E, h_V[dst_idx], vector_field_feat_to_s], dim=-1)
        h_message = self.W13(self.act(self.W12(self.act(self.W11(h_EV)))))
        return self.norm(h_E + self.dropout(h_message))


class VFNContext(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_hidden, num_in, dropout=0.1, num_heads=None, scale=30, node_context=False, edge_context=False):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_hidden, self.num_in, self.scale = num_hidden, num_in, scale
        self.node_context, self.edge_context = node_context, edge_context
        self.V_MLP = nn.Sequential(VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden), nn.ReLU(),
                                   VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden), nn.ReLU(),
                                   VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden))
        self.V_MLP_g = nn.Sequential(VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden), nn.ReLU(),
                                     VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden), nn.ReLU(),
                                     VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, h_V, h_E, edge_idx, batch_id):
        c_V = scatter_mean(h_V, batch_id, dim=0)
        h_V = h_V * self.V_MLP_g(c_V[batch_id])
        return h_V, h_E


class VFNGeneralGNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_hidden, num_in, dropout=0.1, node_context=True, edge_context=False):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_hidden, self.num_in = num_hidden, num_in
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.norm = nn.ModuleList([nn.BatchNorm1d(num_hidden) for _ in range(3)])
        self.attention = VFNNeighborAttention(num_hidden, num_in, num_heads=4)
        self.edge_update = VFNEdgeMLP(num_hidden, num_in, num_heads=4, dropout=dropout)
        self.context = VFNContext(num_hidden, num_in, num_heads=4, node_context=node_context, edge_context=edge_context)
        self.dense = nn.Sequential(VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden * 4), nn.ReLU(),
                                   VLinear(num_hidden * 4, num_hidden))
        self.W11 = VLinear(num_hidden + num_in, num_hidden, bias=True)
        self.W12 = VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden, bias=True)
        self.W13 = VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden, bias=True)
        self.act = torch.nn.GELU()

    def forward(self, h_V, h_E, edge_idx, batch_id, Q_neighbors, h_V_vector):
        src_idx, dst_idx = edge_idx[0], edge_idx[1]
        dh, h_V_vector, vector_field_feat_to_s = self.attention(
            h_V, torch.cat([h_E, h_V[dst_idx]], dim=-1), src_idx, batch_id, dst_idx, Q_neighbors, h_V_vector)
        h_V = self.norm[0](h_V + self.dropout(dh))
        dh = self.dense(h_V)
        h_V = self.norm[1](h_V + self.dropout(dh))
        h_E = self.edge_update(h_V, h_E, edge_idx, batch_id, vector_field_feat_to_s)
        h_V, h_E = self.context(h_V, h_E, edge_idx, batch_id)
        return h_V, h_E, h_V_vector


class StructureEncoder(nn.Module):
    """Featurizer (pifold_featurizer.py) + VFN input layer and encoder (VFN.py:110-140)."""

    def __init__(self, hidden_dim=128, num_layers=15, k_neighbors=30, dropout=0.1, num_rbf=16):
        super().__init__()
        node_features = edge_features = hidden_dim
        self.top_k, self.num_vec = k_neighbors, _VFN_CFG['num_vec']
        # Pifold_featurizer(cfg): virtual_num 3 (its only parameter; unused by the VFN forward)
        self.virtual_atoms = nn.Parameter(torch.rand(3, 3))
        self.register_buffer('xyz_mean', torch.tensor([[-5.2663e-01, 1.3599e+00, -1.2915e-10],
                                                       [1.5254e+00, -6.1342e-09, -2.8615e-10],
                                                       [2.1513e+00, -1.4534e-01, -1.3165e-02]]), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer('xyz_std', torch.tensor([[6.4174e-02, 2.5685e-02, 3.8159e-08],
                                                      [1.1167e-02, 6.7004e-08, 3.5351e-08],
                                                      [2.1300e-02, 8.1443e-01, 6.6397e-01]]), persistent=False)
        # VFN.__init__
        self.node_embedding = VLinear(224, node_features, bias=True)
        self.edge_embedding = VLinear(416, edge_features, bias=True)
        self.norm_nodes = nn.BatchNorm1d(node_features)
        self.norm_edges = nn.BatchNorm1d(edge_features)
        self.W_v = nn.Sequential(VLinear(node_features, hidden_dim, bias=True), nn.LeakyReLU(),
                                 nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
                                 VLinear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, bias=True), nn.LeakyReLU(),
                                 nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
                                 VLinear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, bias=True))
        self.W_e = VLinear(edge_features, hidden_dim, bias=True)
        self.encoder_layers = nn.Sequential(*[VFNGeneralGNN(hidden_dim, hidden_dim * 2, dropout=dropout)
                                              for _ in range(num_layers)])
        self.init_vector = VLinear(hidden_dim, self.num_vec * 3, bias=True)
        self.vector_field_linear = FakeLinear(12, 32, "geometric")
        self.gbf = GaussianNondeLayer(32)

    def _featurize(self, X, mask):
        # Pifold_featurizer.forward, the parts the VFN forward reads.
        mask_bool = mask.bool()
        B, N = X.shape[0], X.shape[1]
        gt_frame = _vfn_backbone_frames(X)
        X_ca = gt_frame._t
        mask_2D = torch.unsqueeze(mask, 1) * torch.unsqueeze(mask, 2)
        dX = torch.unsqueeze(X_ca, 1) - torch.unsqueeze(X_ca, 2)
        D = (1. - mask_2D) * 10000 + mask_2D * torch.sqrt(torch.sum(dX ** 2, 3) + 1e-6)
        D_max, _ = torch.max(D, -1, keepdim=True)
        D_adjust = D + (1. - mask_2D) * (D_max + 1)
        top_k = min(self.top_k, D_adjust.shape[-1])
        _, E_idx = torch.topk(D_adjust, top_k, dim=-1, largest=False)
        mask_attend = _vfn_gather_nodes(mask.unsqueeze(-1), E_idx).squeeze(-1)
        mask_attend = (mask.unsqueeze(-1) * mask_attend) == 1
        node_mask_select = lambda x: torch.masked_select(x, mask_bool.unsqueeze(-1)).reshape(-1, x.shape[-1])
        # pifold_utils.py:134-161: neighbour frames relative to the centre frame
        gt_frame_repeated = gt_frame[:, None].repeat([1, gt_frame.shape[1], 1])
        Q_neighbors = gt_frame_repeated.gather(dim=-1, index=E_idx)
        Q_neighbors = gt_frame[..., None].decompose(Q_neighbors)
        Q_neighbors = Q_neighbors[mask_attend]
        # local backbone atoms (pifold_featurizer.py:188-230)
        Calpha_mask = torch.tensor([True, False, True, True], dtype=torch.bool, device=X.device)
        X_local_noise = gt_frame[:, :, None].invert_apply(X)
        Calpha = X_local_noise[:, :, 1:2, :]
        X_feat = X_local_noise[:, :, Calpha_mask, :] - Calpha
        X_feat = X_feat.reshape(X.shape[0], X.shape[1], 3 * 3)
        V_xyz = node_mask_select(X_feat)
        V_xyz = V_xyz.reshape(-1, 3, 3)
        clamp_max = (self.xyz_mean + 8 * self.xyz_std).reshape(1, 9)
        clamp_min = (self.xyz_mean - 8 * self.xyz_std).reshape(1, 9)
        V_xyz_flatten = torch.clamp(V_xyz.reshape(-1, 9), clamp_min, clamp_max)
        V_xyz = V_xyz_flatten.reshape(V_xyz.shape)
        if V_xyz.max() > 3 or V_xyz.min() < -3:
            index = torch.where(torch.abs(V_xyz) > 3)
            V_xyz[index] = self.xyz_mean[index[1], index[2]]
        ori_V_xyz = V_xyz
        V_xyz = torch.cat([torch.zeros(V_xyz.shape[0], 1, 3, device=V_xyz.device), V_xyz], dim=1)
        gt_frame_selected = gt_frame[mask_bool]
        V_xyz = gt_frame_selected[:, None].apply(V_xyz)
        V_xyz_left = torch.cat([V_xyz[1:], V_xyz[-1, 0][None, None].repeat(1, 4, 1)])
        V_xyz_right = torch.cat([V_xyz[0, 0][None, None].repeat(1, 4, 1), V_xyz[:-1]])
        V_xyz = torch.cat([V_xyz, V_xyz_left, V_xyz_right], dim=1)
        V_xyz = gt_frame_selected[:, None].invert_apply(V_xyz)
        # edge index over the flattened valid residues (pifold_featurizer.py:290-301)
        mask_index = mask.cumsum(dim=1) - 1
        mask_src_index = mask_index[:, None].repeat(1, mask_index.shape[1], 1)
        mask_dst_index = mask_index[:, :, None].repeat(1, 1, top_k)
        E_idx = torch.gather(mask_src_index, dim=-1, index=E_idx)
        shift = mask.sum(dim=1).cumsum(dim=0) - mask.sum(dim=1)
        src = torch.masked_select(shift.view(B, 1, 1) + E_idx, mask_attend).view(1, -1)
        dst = torch.masked_select(shift.view(B, 1, 1) + mask_dst_index, mask_attend).view(1, -1)
        P_idx = torch.cat((dst, src), dim=0).long()
        batch_id = mask.nonzero()[:, 0]
        n_edges = P_idx.shape[1]
        return P_idx, batch_id, Q_neighbors, (V_xyz, ori_V_xyz), n_edges

    def forward(self, X, mask):
        P_idx, batch_id, Q_neighbors, V_xyz, n_edges = self._featurize(X, mask)
        # VFN.forward (VFN.py:110-140)
        V_xyz, ori_V_xyz = V_xyz
        V_xyz = self.vector_field_linear(V_xyz)
        V_xyz_dist = V_xyz.norm(dim=-1) + 1e-6
        V_xyz_sin_cos = V_xyz / V_xyz_dist[..., None]
        V_xyz_dist = self.gbf(V_xyz_dist)
        h_V = torch.cat([V_xyz_sin_cos.flatten(start_dim=1), V_xyz_dist], dim=1)
        h_V = self.W_v(self.norm_nodes(self.node_embedding(h_V)))
        h_P = self.edge_embedding(torch.ones(n_edges, 416, dtype=h_V.dtype, device=h_V.device))
        h_V_vector = _tensor_to_vec(self.init_vector(h_V))
        seq_len, vec_num = h_V_vector.shape[0], h_V_vector.shape[1]
        h_V_vector = h_V_vector.view(-1, 4, vec_num // 4, 3)
        h_V_vector[:, :, 0, :] = torch.cat([torch.zeros(ori_V_xyz.shape[0], 1, 3).to(ori_V_xyz.device), ori_V_xyz], dim=1)
        h_V_vector = h_V_vector.view(seq_len, vec_num, 3)
        for layer in self.encoder_layers:
            h_V, h_P, h_V_vector = layer(h_V, h_P, P_idx, batch_id, Q_neighbors, h_V_vector)
        return h_V


class InverseFoldingModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_dim=128, num_encoder_layers=15, k_neighbors=30,
                 dropout=0.1, num_rbf=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder = StructureEncoder(hidden_dim=hidden_dim, num_layers=num_encoder_layers,
                                        k_neighbors=k_neighbors, dropout=dropout, num_rbf=num_rbf)
        self.readout = VLinear(hidden_dim, NUM_AA, init='final')   # MLPDecoder, vocab 20

    def forward(self, X, mask):
        h_flat = self.encoder(X, mask)
        lp_flat = F.log_softmax(self.readout(h_flat), dim=-1)
        out = torch.full(tuple(mask.shape) + (NUM_AA,), -float(np.log(NUM_AA)),
                         dtype=lp_flat.dtype, device=lp_flat.device)
        out[mask.bool()] = lp_flat
        return out

+# =====================================================================

+# =====================================================================
+# VFN-IF (Mao et al., "De novo Protein Design Using Geometric Vector Field
+# Networks", ICLR 2024 spotlight; arXiv:2310.11802), ported from the authors'
+# code, github.com/aim-uofa/VFN @ 9f5b1e12bf2d6bc4b7fdc1f188a837a17daa77dd,
+# directory VFN-IF/ (file:line references are to that commit):
+#   input     unifold/modules/denoise.py:66-103 (Denosie.forward), backbone frames
+#             unifold/data/data_ops.py:1012-1133,1313-1316 (atom37_to_frames, group 0)
+#   featurizer unifold/modules/inverse_module_utils/pifold_featurizer.py:8-310
+#             (+ pifold_utils.py:134-161 _orientations_coarse_gl_tuple_uni_backen,
+#              :250-254 gather_nodes; modules/frame.py Rotation/Frame)
+#   model     unifold/modules/VFN.py:7-144 (VFN), prodesign_module.py:16-410
+#             (NeighborAttention, EdgeMLP, Context, GeneralGNN, StructureEncoder,
+#              MLPDecoder), common.py:20-75,77-141,245-299,458-515 (Linear inits,
+#              GeoVecMLP, VecLinear, FakeLinear, GeoVecLinear, GaussianLayer,
+#              GaussianNondeLayer, residual, vec<->tensor)
+#   config    unifold/config.py:300-344 (VFN defaults) + :685-692
+#             (VFN_baseline_wo_node_feat_15l), train_script/layers/
+#             x2_vecdirect_noedge_atom_gbf_nofeat_15l.sh (batch 8, lr 1e-3)
+# Faithful, no deviations: every module, flag and initialisation of the
+# released VFN_baseline_wo_node_feat_15l model, including the reference's
+# parameters that the forward pass never reads (featurizer virtual atoms,
+# norm_edges, W_e, per-layer W11-13 / norm[2] / Context.V_MLP /
+# vector_dist_bn / h_V_vector_edge_mlp), so the parameter set equals the
+# reference model's. The released forward discards the featurizer's
+# hand-crafted node/edge features (VFN.py:117-119 rebuild h_V from the
+# backbone atoms and set the edge input to a constant 1), so those dead
+# feature tensors are not computed here; everything the forward reads
+# (kNN graph, frames, neighbour frames, local backbone atoms) is.
+# The harness mask plays the reference's seq_mask (residues the model sees);
+# the flat per-residue logits are scattered back to (B, L, 20) log-probs
+# (residues outside the mask: uniform, never scored).
+
+import numpy as np
+from torch_scatter import scatter_sum, scatter_softmax, scatter_mean
+
+
+# ---- modules/frame.py (Rotation / Frame, the subset the model uses) ----
+class _VRotation:
+    def __init__(self, mat):
+        self._mat = mat
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def mat_mul_mat(a, b):
+        return (a.float() @ b.float()).type(a.dtype)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def mat_mul_vec(r, t):
+        return (r.float() @ t.float().unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1).type(t.dtype)
+
+    def __getitem__(self, index):
+        if not isinstance(index, tuple):
+            index = (index,)
+        return _VRotation(self._mat[index + (slice(None), slice(None))])
+
+    def __matmul__(self, other):
+        return _VRotation(_VRotation.mat_mul_mat(self._mat, other._mat))
+
+    def invert(self):
+        return _VRotation(self._mat.transpose(-1, -2))
+
+    def apply(self, pts):
+        return _VRotation.mat_mul_vec(self._mat, pts)
+
+    def invert_apply(self, pts):
+        return _VRotation.mat_mul_vec(self._mat.transpose(-1, -2), pts)
+
+
+class _VFrame:
+    def __init__(self, rotation, translation):
+        self._r = rotation
+        self._t = translation
+
+    @property
+    def shape(self):
+        return self._t.shape[:-1]
+
+    def __getitem__(self, index):
+        if type(index) != tuple:
+            index = (index,)
+        return _VFrame(self._r[index], self._t[index + (slice(None),)])
+
+    def compose(self, other):
+        return _VFrame(self._r @ other._r, self._r.apply(other._t) + self._t)
+
+    def decompose(self, other):
+        return _VFrame(self._r.invert() @ other._r, self._r.invert_apply(other._t - self._t))
+
+    def apply(self, pts):
+        return self._r.apply(pts) + self._t
+
+    def invert_apply(self, pts):
+        return self._r.invert_apply(pts - self._t)
+
+    def repeat(self, repeat_size):
+        self._r._mat = self._r._mat.repeat(repeat_size + [1, 1])
+        self._t = self._t.repeat(repeat_size + [1])
+        return self
+
+    def gather(self, dim, index):
+        if dim < 0:
+            dim = len(self.shape) + dim
+        shape_index = list(index.shape)
+        index_r = index[..., None, None].expand(shape_index + [3, 3])
+        index_t = index[..., None].expand(shape_index + [3])
+        self._r._mat = torch.gather(self._r._mat, dim=dim, index=index_r)
+        self._t = torch.gather(self._t, dim=dim, index=index_t)
+        return self
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def from_3_points(p_neg_x_axis, origin, p_xy_plane, eps=1e-8):
+        p_neg_x_axis = torch.unbind(p_neg_x_axis, dim=-1)
+        origin = torch.unbind(origin, dim=-1)
+        p_xy_plane = torch.unbind(p_xy_plane, dim=-1)
+        e0 = [c1 - c2 for c1, c2 in zip(origin, p_neg_x_axis)]
+        e1 = [c1 - c2 for c1, c2 in zip(p_xy_plane, origin)]
+        denom = torch.sqrt(sum((c * c for c in e0)) + eps)
+        e0 = [c / denom for c in e0]
+        dot = sum((c1 * c2 for c1, c2 in zip(e0, e1)))
+        e1 = [c2 - c1 * dot for c1, c2 in zip(e0, e1)]
+        denom = torch.sqrt(sum((c * c for c in e1)) + eps)
+        e1 = [c / denom for c in e1]
+        e2 = [e0[1] * e1[2] - e0[2] * e1[1],
+              e0[2] * e1[0] - e0[0] * e1[2],
+              e0[0] * e1[1] - e0[1] * e1[0]]
+        rots = torch.stack([c for tup in zip(e0, e1, e2) for c in tup], dim=-1)
+        rots = rots.reshape(rots.shape[:-1] + (3, 3))
+        return _VFrame(_VRotation(rots), torch.stack(origin, dim=-1))
+
+
+def _vfn_backbone_frames(X):
+    # data_ops.py:1012-1133 atom37_to_frames, rigid group 0 (base atoms C, CA, N for
+    # every residue type) composed with diag(-1, 1, -1); :1313 true_frame_tensor.
+    gt = _VFrame.from_3_points(p_neg_x_axis=X[..., 2, :], origin=X[..., 1, :],
+                               p_xy_plane=X[..., 0, :], eps=1e-8)
+    rots = torch.eye(3, dtype=X.dtype, device=X.device)
+    rots[0, 0] = -1
+    rots[2, 2] = -1
+    rots = rots.expand(gt.shape + (3, 3))
+    return gt.compose(_VFrame(_VRotation(rots), torch.zeros(gt.shape + (3,), dtype=X.dtype,
+                                                            device=X.device)))
+
+
+def _vfn_gather_nodes(nodes, neighbor_idx):
+    neighbors_flat = neighbor_idx.view((neighbor_idx.shape[0], -1))
+    neighbors_flat = neighbors_flat.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, nodes.size(2))
+    neighbor_features = torch.gather(nodes, 1, neighbors_flat)
+    return neighbor_features.view(list(neighbor_idx.shape)[:3] + [-1])
+
+
+# ---- modules/common.py ----
+class VLinear(nn.Linear):
+    def __init__(self, d_in, d_out, bias=True, init="default"):
+        super().__init__(d_in, d_out, bias=bias)
+        self.use_bias = bias
+        if self.use_bias:
+            with torch.no_grad():
+                self.bias.fill_(0)
+        if init in ("default", "glorot"):
+            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.weight, gain=1)
+        elif init == "final":
+            self._zero_init(False)
+        else:
+            raise ValueError("Invalid init method.")
+
+    def _zero_init(self, use_bias=True):
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            self.weight.fill_(0.0)
+            if use_bias:
+                self.bias.fill_(1.0)
+
+
+def _vfn_residual(residual, x, training):
+    if training:
+        return x + residual
+    residual += x
+    return residual
+
+
+def _vec_to_tensor(vec):
+    return vec.flatten(1)
+
+
+def _tensor_to_vec(tensor):
+    return tensor.reshape(tensor.shape[0], -1, 3)
+
+
+class GeoVecLinear(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, num_vec_in, num_vec_out, bias=False):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.num_vec_in, self.num_vec_out, self.bias_enable = num_vec_in, num_vec_out, bias
+        if num_vec_in == num_vec_out:
+            self.Linear = VLinear(num_vec_in, num_vec_in, bias=False, init="final")
+        else:
+            self.Linear = VLinear(num_vec_in, num_vec_out, bias=False)
+        if self.bias_enable:
+            self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_vec_out, 3))
+
+    def forward(self, vec):
+        if self.num_vec_in == self.num_vec_out:
+            vec_update = self.Linear(vec.transpose(-2, -1)).transpose(-2, -1)
+            if self.bias_enable:
+                vec_update = vec_update + self.bias[None]
+            return _vfn_residual(vec, vec_update, self.training)
+        vec = self.Linear(vec.transpose(-2, -1)).transpose(-2, -1)
+        if self.bias_enable:
+            vec = vec + self.bias[None]
+        return vec
+
+
+class VecLinear(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, num_vec_in, num_vec_out, type):
+        super().__init__()
+        assert type == "geometric"
+        self.Linear = GeoVecLinear(num_vec_in, num_vec_out)
+
+    def forward(self, vec):
+        return self.Linear(vec)
+
+
+class FakeLinear(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, num_vec_in, num_vec_out, type):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.num_vec_in, self.num_vec_out, self.type = num_vec_in, num_vec_out, type
+        self.linear = VLinear(num_vec_in * 3, num_vec_out * 3)
+
+    def forward(self, vec):
+        vec = vec.reshape(vec.shape[0], -1)
+        vec = self.linear(vec)
+        return vec.reshape(vec.shape[0], self.num_vec_out, 3)
+
+
+class GeoVecMLP(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, num_vec_in, n=2, dropout=0.1):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.num_vec_in, self.n = num_vec_in, n
+        self.Linear1 = GeoVecLinear(num_vec_in, num_vec_in * n, bias=True)
+        self.Linear2 = GeoVecLinear(num_vec_in * n, num_vec_in, bias=True)
+        self.Linear2.Linear._zero_init(False)
+        self.dir_vec = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(num_vec_in * n, 3))
+        self.dropout = dropout
+        self.drop_n = int(num_vec_in * dropout)
+        self.scale_factor = 1.0 / (1 - self.drop_n / num_vec_in)
+
+    def forward(self, vec):
+        vec_res = vec
+        vec = self.Linear1(vec)
+        cos_sim = torch.einsum("bnc,nc->bn", vec, self.dir_vec) / (
+            torch.norm(vec, dim=-1) * torch.norm(self.dir_vec, dim=-1) + 1e-8)
+        dir_factor = (cos_sim + 1) / 2
+        vec = vec * dir_factor.unsqueeze(-1)
+        vec = self.Linear2(vec)
+        if self.training:
+            dropmask = torch.rand(vec.shape[:2], device=vec.device) <= self.dropout
+            vec[dropmask] = 0
+            vec = vec * self.scale_factor
+        return vec + vec_res
+
+
+class GeoVecMLPMultiLayers(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, num_vec_in, n=2, num_layers=2):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.layers = nn.Sequential(*[GeoVecMLP(num_vec_in, n) for _ in range(num_layers)])
+
+    def forward(self, vec):
+        return self.layers(vec)
+
+
+def _vfn_gaussian(x, mean, std):
+    return torch.exp(-0.5 * (((x - mean) / std) ** 2))
+
+
+class GaussianLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, num_hidden, num_vec, K=4):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.mean = VLinear(num_hidden * 2, num_vec * K, init="final")
+        self.var = VLinear(num_hidden * 2, num_vec * K, init="final")
+        self.anchor_means = nn.Parameter(torch.linspace(0, 20, K)[None].repeat(num_vec, 1), requires_grad=False)
+        self.anchor_var = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_vec, K) * (20 / (K / 2)), requires_grad=False)
+
+    def forward(self, x, h_src, h_dst):
+        nodes = torch.cat([h_src, h_dst], dim=-1)
+        mean = self.mean(nodes)
+        var = self.var(nodes)
+        mean = mean.view(mean.shape[0], -1, 4)
+        var = var.view(mean.shape[0], -1, 4)
+        mean = (mean + self.anchor_means[None]).abs()
+        var = (var + self.anchor_var[None]).abs() + 0.5
+        return _vfn_gaussian(x[..., None], mean, var).flatten(1, 2)
+
+
+class GaussianNondeLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, num_vec, K=4):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.anchor_means = nn.Parameter(torch.linspace(0, 20, K)[None].repeat(num_vec, 1), requires_grad=False)
+        self.anchor_var = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_vec, K) * (20 / (K / 2)), requires_grad=False)
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        mean = (self.anchor_means[None]).abs()
+        var = (self.anchor_var[None]).abs() + 0.5
+        return _vfn_gaussian(x[..., None], mean, var).flatten(1, 2)
+
+
+# ---- modules/prodesign_module.py (VFN_baseline_wo_node_feat_15l flags) ----
+_VFN_CFG = dict(num_vec=32, vec_mlp_n=2, vec_num_mlp_layer=2, vec_learnable=True,
+                use_simple_mlp=False, use_simple_relu=False, use_simple_gvp=False,
+                enable_vec_direct=True, dist_gbf=True, decompose=True,
+                use_mlp_in_edge=True, disable_edge_module=False,
+                use_vec_update_edge=True, cross_update=False,
+                vector_field_post_vec_norm=False, init_vec='linear',
+                per_layer_supervision=False)
+
+
+class VFNNeighborAttention(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, num_hidden, num_in, num_heads=4, edge_drop=0.0, output_mlp=True):
+        super().__init__()
+        c = _VFN_CFG
+        self.num_heads, self.num_hidden, self.edge_drop, self.output_mlp = num_heads, num_hidden, edge_drop, output_mlp
+        self.num_vec = c['num_vec']
+        self.W_V = nn.Sequential(VLinear(num_in, num_hidden), nn.GELU(),
+                                 VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden), nn.GELU(),
+                                 VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden))
+        self.vector_V = VecLinear(self.num_vec, self.num_vec, "geometric")
+        self.Bias = nn.Sequential(VLinear(num_hidden * 3, num_hidden), nn.ReLU(),
+                                  VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden), nn.ReLU(),
+                                  VLinear(num_hidden, num_heads * 2))
+        self.W_O = VLinear(num_hidden, num_hidden, bias=False)
+        self.edge_vector_field_linear = VecLinear(self.num_vec * 2, self.num_vec, "geometric")
+        self.edge_vector_field_linear.Linear.Linear._zero_init(False)
+        self.vector_dist_bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(self.num_vec)
+        self.final_vector_output = VLinear(self.num_vec * 3, self.num_vec * 3, bias=True, init='final')
+        self.vec_merge_v_src = VecLinear(self.num_vec * 2, self.num_vec, "geometric")
+        self.vec_merge_v_src.Linear.Linear._zero_init(False)
+        self.vec_merge_v_src_mlp = GeoVecMLPMultiLayers(self.num_vec, n=c['vec_mlp_n'], num_layers=c['vec_num_mlp_layer'])
+        self.h_V_vector_edge_mlp = GeoVecMLPMultiLayers(self.num_vec, n=c['vec_mlp_n'], num_layers=c['vec_num_mlp_layer'])
+        self.softmax_dropout = 0.2
+        self.gbf = GaussianLayer(num_hidden, self.num_vec)
+        self.h_e_reducer = VLinear(num_hidden * 2 + 4 * self.num_vec + 3 * self.num_vec, num_hidden * 2, bias=False)
+
+    def forward(self, h_V, h_E, center_id, batch_id, dst_idx=None, frame_dst=None, h_V_vector=None):
+        E = h_E.shape[0]
+        n_heads = self.num_heads
+        d = int(self.num_hidden / n_heads)
+        h_V_vector_init = h_V_vector
+        h_V_vector_src = h_V_vector[center_id]
+        h_V_vector_dst = h_V_vector[dst_idx]
+        h_V_vector_dst_trans = frame_dst[:, None].apply(h_V_vector_dst)
+        h_V_vector_edge = torch.cat([h_V_vector_dst_trans, h_V_vector_src], dim=-2)
+        h_V_vector_edge = self.edge_vector_field_linear(h_V_vector_edge) + h_V_vector_dst_trans
+        h_V_vector_dist = h_V_vector_edge.norm(dim=-1) + 1e-6
+        h_V_vector_edge_sin_cos = h_V_vector_edge / h_V_vector_dist[..., None]
+        h_V_vector_dist = self.gbf(h_V_vector_dist, h_V[center_id], h_V[dst_idx])
+        vector_field_feat_to_s = torch.cat([h_V_vector_edge_sin_cos.flatten(start_dim=1), h_V_vector_dist], dim=1)
+        h_E = torch.cat([vector_field_feat_to_s, h_E], dim=-1)
+        h_E = self.h_e_reducer(h_E)
+        dtype = h_V.dtype
+        w = self.Bias(torch.cat([h_V[center_id], h_E], dim=-1)).view(E, n_heads * 2, 1)
+        w = w.float()
+        attend_logits = w / np.sqrt(d)
+        if self.softmax_dropout > 0 and self.training:
+            mask = torch.rand_like(attend_logits, dtype=dtype) < self.softmax_dropout
+            attend_logits.masked_fill_(mask, -float('inf'))
+        V = self.W_V(h_E).view(-1, n_heads, d)
+        attend = scatter_softmax(attend_logits, index=center_id, dim=0)
+        attend = attend.type(dtype)
+        attend, attend_vector = attend.split([4, 4], dim=1)
+        h_V = scatter_sum(attend * V, center_id, dim=0).view([-1, self.num_hidden])
+        h_V_update = self.W_O(h_V) if self.output_mlp else h_V
+        h_V_vector_edge_v = self.vector_V(h_V_vector_dst_trans)
+        # rearrange 'l (h v) c -> l h v c'
+        h_V_vector_edge_v = h_V_vector_edge_v.reshape(h_V_vector_edge_v.shape[0], n_heads, -1, 3)
+        h_V_vector_v = scatter_sum(attend_vector[..., None] * h_V_vector_edge_v, center_id, dim=0).flatten(1, 2)
+        h_V_vector_v = self.vec_merge_v_src(torch.cat([h_V_vector_v, h_V_vector], dim=-2)) + h_V_vector_v
+        h_V_vector_v = self.vec_merge_v_src_mlp(h_V_vector_v)
+        h_V_vector_v = _vec_to_tensor(h_V_vector_v)
+        h_V_vector = self.final_vector_output(h_V_vector_v)
+        h_V_vector = _tensor_to_vec(h_V_vector)
+        h_V_vector = h_V_vector + h_V_vector_init
+        return h_V_update, h_V_vector, vector_field_feat_to_s
+
+

+        self.num_hidden, self.num_in, self.scale, self.num_vec = num_hidden, num_in, scale, c['num_vec']

Protein Inverse Folding — Self-contained template.
Given backbone structure (N, CA, C, O coordinates), predict amino acid sequence.

import os

import time

import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Optional, Tuple

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader

# ---- Constants ----
ALPHABET = 'ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY'
NUM_AA = 20  # 20 standard amino acids
NUM_BB_ATOMS = 4  # N, CA, C, O

def _rbf(D, D_min=0., D_max=20., D_count=16, device='cpu'):
    """Radial basis function encoding of distances."""
    D_mu = torch.linspace(D_min, D_max, D_count, device=device)
    D_mu = D_mu.view([1, -1])
    D_sigma = (D_max - D_min) / D_count
    D_expand = torch.unsqueeze(D, -1)
    return torch.exp(-((D_expand - D_mu) / D_sigma) ** 2)

def _dihedrals(X, eps=1e-7):
    """Compute backbone dihedral angles (phi, psi, omega) from N-CA-C-O coords.
    X: (B, L, 4, 3) — N, CA, C, O coordinates.
    Returns: (B, L, 6) — sin/cos of 3 dihedral angles.
    """
    X_flat = X[:, :, :3, :].reshape(int(X.shape[0]), -1, 3)  # (B, 3L, 3)
    dX = X_flat[:, 1:, :] - X_flat[:, :-1, :]  # (B, 3L-1, 3)
    U = F.normalize(dX, dim=-1)
    u_2 = U[:, :-2, :]
    u_1 = U[:, 1:-1, :]
    u_0 = U[:, 2:, :]
    n_2 = F.normalize(torch.cross(u_2, u_1, dim=-1), dim=-1)
    n_1 = F.normalize(torch.cross(u_1, u_0, dim=-1), dim=-1)
    cos_d = (n_2 * n_1).sum(-1)
    sin_d = (torch.cross(n_2, n_1, dim=-1) * u_1).sum(-1)
    cos_d = cos_d.clamp(-1 + eps, 1 - eps)
    sin_d = sin_d.clamp(-1 + eps, 1 - eps)
    D = torch.stack([cos_d, sin_d], dim=-1)  # (B, 3L-3, 2)
    # Pad to (B, L, 6) — 3 dihedrals per residue
    D = F.pad(D, (0, 0, 1, 2))  # pad the length
    B, N = int(X.shape[0]), int(X.shape[1])
    D = D.reshape(B, -1, 6)[:, :N, :]
    return D

def _orientations(X):
    """Compute local orientation frames from N-CA-C coords.
    Returns forward and binormal unit vectors. (B, L, 6)
    """
    fwd = F.normalize(X[:, 1:, 1, :] - X[:, :-1, 1, :], dim=-1)  # CA-CA
    fwd = F.pad(fwd, (0, 0, 0, 1))
    u = F.normalize(X[:, :, 2, :] - X[:, :, 1, :], dim=-1)  # C-CA
    b = F.normalize(fwd - (fwd * u).sum(-1, keepdim=True) * u, dim=-1)
    return torch.cat([fwd, b], dim=-1)

def knn_graph(X_ca, mask, k=30):
    """Build k-nearest neighbor graph from CA coordinates.
    X_ca: (B, L, 3), mask: (B, L)
    Returns: E_idx (B, L, K), D_neighbors (B, L, K)
    """
    mask_2D = mask.unsqueeze(1) * mask.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, L, L)
    dX = X_ca.unsqueeze(1) - X_ca.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, L, L, 3)
    D = mask_2D * torch.sqrt((dX ** 2).sum(-1) + 1e-6) + (1 - mask_2D) * 1e6
    D_neighbors, E_idx = torch.topk(D, min(k, int(D.shape[-1])), dim=-1, largest=False)
    return E_idx, D_neighbors
